title: Update cookie pop up behavior
body:
Blocked by https://github.com/confio/tgrade-landing/issues/27

The Cookies button for managing cookies preferences will now live on the try.tgrade.finance/<cookie-policy?> page, so we'll remove it from the app once that's done.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Expected behavior updated 14.04:

- to not show the cookie pop up if the user has already visited one of the other pages under *.tgrade.finance
- show the pop up if they have not visited othe *.tgrade.finance pages

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @ks-victor just to confirm, we don't have to show the cookies button on dapp.tgrade.finance because it is shown in try.tgrade.finance?

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
First time a user hits our pages where we use cookies, they should be prompted for the cookie banner (which cover all the pages under *.tgrade.finance)

So if the first visit is to dapp.tgrade.finance, then the banner should be shown and if the user then visits tgrade.finance, then it should not be shown.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Ok, right now it is shown on each app for the first visit. So the task would be to not show the cookie pop up if the user has already visited one of the other pages under *.tgrade.finance

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: Yes. But I think that works too. At least it did when I tried yesterday.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Ah yes, it worked for me now as well

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
